name: aes
description: Symmetrical encryption and decryption (AES-256-GCM) utilizing native Web Crypto API. Fully cross-platform.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when encrypting sensitive data locally (like database passwords, session data caches, or sensitive messages in transit) without using external crypto-js or node-only modules. Import using: import { encrypt, decrypt } from './crypto/aes.js';
